source: RFC 9901 sections 4.2.1 (disclosure of an object property), 4.2.2 (disclosure of an array element) and 4.2.3 (hashing disclosures)
rule: digest = base64url(SHA-256(ASCII(disclosure))), the disclosure being the base64url text exactly as it travels

digest.note: the digest is the same function; the UMIS profile parser rejects array-element disclosures
